coordinator.rationale: Ready-made product teams supply lead/CEO/CTO roles. Shipped team instructions tell the designated lead to route tasks to teammates through 5dive and report results to the owner. Create agents, import a ready-made team or install the product skill, then use the role-specific instructions and CLI to route work. Provider credentials stay in named auth profiles. agent ask waits for an answer; agent send delivers a message without a requested answer. The shipped instructions explicitly distinguish this team from Claude Codes native session subagents. Tasks filed with --tell-me or watched with task watch wake the routing lead when they close, after which it reports the result to the owner.

issue-tracking.rationale: The product owns SQLite-backed tasks with title/body, stable identity, assignment and priority. Task state persists in the native tasks table separately from task_sessions; status starts as todo, while assignment, review and delivery are separately recorded. The core CLI can create/assign work directly in its own queue. GitHub/webhooks are optional intake routes.
